_provenance: NOAA CPC NMME 'tercile summary' display rules as relayed by CAPC-AC (display_rules_probabistic_forecast): the dominant category is shown only where its probability exceeds 38% AND the opposite outer tercile is under 33% (secondary_max); a near-normal runner-up does not blank it ('in the case that A is >38% and N is >33%, A will be shown'), while a leading near-normal needs both outer terciles under 33%. Otherwise the cell is white -- every tercile under 38%, or both outer terciles over it. Rules text: cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/NMME/NMME_PROB_descr.html. Wet tendency in a blue scale, dry tendency in an orange scale, normal tendency in a green scale, dry season (climatology under 1 mm) in grey. The rules name the colours but not their hex values; the ramps here are the standard sequential Blues / Oranges / Greens, banded 38-50-60-70-80-90-100.
